scenarios.scenario-1: User image attachments with `dataUrl` map into OpenAI-style `image_url` multimodal content parts on image-capable routes.
scenarios.scenario-2: Persisted sessions omit transient `dataUrl`, preserving future gating boundary between live send and replay state.
scenarios.scenario-3: Non-image-capable routes degrade image attachments to text-only turns instead of sending multimodal payload parts.
scenarios.scenario-4: Explicit `/models` capability metadata overrides heuristic route guessing and drives live image-send decisions.
